purpose: Blinded eight-site Moon/Mars-Earth morphology method review
limitations: All reference and Earth sites were available during method design; this is not a new geographic holdout or prospective discovery benchmark.
The eight Earth sites are roughly 3 km crops with overlapping windows; 120 pairs do not represent 120 independent landforms.
A random gallery control is not a verified negative analog. Top-five results outside the judged pool remain unjudged.
Published geologic maps are cartographic polygons, not observed rock exposure or per-window mineral truth; Moon/Mars matching material data remain incomplete.
No independent ratings exist at freeze time; do not report model superiority, global Recall@5, or a new valid analog discovery from this pack alone.
